objective: Computation on the same maps. Measure uniform canonical rules for reading the atoms (yes/no two-stage twins, native row twins, maximal twin cliques, twins vetoed by refinement, twins compatible at glue lines), describe the spaces they fail on, and record the glue-compatibility regularity.
status: Proved by exact computation on 191 saved and 86 fresh maps: five uniform canonical rules read 219 (yes/no two-stage) and 234 (native row twins, maximal twin cliques, refinement-vetoed twins, glue-compatible twins) of 277 spaces; native twins fail only by merging atoms (38, 32 by complete twinship of two whole atoms); regularity: native-twin lines of one atom are always compatible at glue lines (17,494 of 17,494), across atoms 1,042 of 1,572
title: Uniform rules on the native map
